prompt.es: Escribe tu desenlace alternativo (unas 100 palabras): decisión, escenarios y reflexión.

answer.text: At twenty-five, I left my hometown to study design in Lima, although I had a safe job. Had I stayed, I would have kept my salary, but I would never have pursued my passion. But for my courage, I would probably still be working in the same office. Were it not for that risk, my life would be much smaller today, and I would not be as happy as I am now. In hindsight, leaving was the turning point of my life. The decision was difficult, but it was worthwhile, and I am proud that I was brave enough to take it.

When I was twenty-five, I decided to leave my hometown and study design in Lima, even though I had a safe job. Were it not for that decision, I would still be in the same office, and I would not be as happy as I am today. But for my courage, none of this would have happened. In hindsight, it was the turning point of my life, and it was worthwhile.
